specs.family: 同到期双翼反向比例结构
specs.thesis: 在相同到期日买入两侧翼、卖出较少中央跨式；尾部斜率可以向上，但肩部亏损、路径风险和真实成本必须独立通过。
specs.premium_cashflow_model: Entry credit or debit is computed from atomic-combo or timestamped leg fills; financing is carried to each valuation date, and shoulder loss, fees, assignment, hedge and liquidation cashflows remain separate.
greek_surface_risk: leg-level gross and net Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta and higher-order cancellation
spot × time × skew × term-surface full revaluation
jump, pin, early-exercise, assignment and margin residual
specs.sizing_contract: Choose integer contracts only after matching premium, tail-loss and survival budgets to baselines; enforce q_p>q_s and q_c>q_s for the declared two-upward-tail identity; no source quantity is a default.
data_requirements: point-in-time option chain with contract identity and corporate-action history
side-and-size-aware bid, ask, depth, combo and fill observations
underlying, rates, dividends, borrow, settlement and exercise data
historical volatility surface and account-specific margin snapshots

parameter_registry.name: source_structure
parameter_registry.source_value: long OTM put and call; short fewer ATM straddles
parameter_registry.prohibition: 不得把图中视觉比例当作生产默认。

parameter_registry.name: strike_expiry_quantity_grid
parameter_registry.prohibition: 只允许由 point-in-time 训练数据产生并在冻结 holdout 检验。

parameter_registry.name: tail_slope_constraint
parameter_registry.source_value: q_p > q_s and q_c > q_s for two upward tail slopes
parameter_registry.prohibition: 不满足时不得标注为双尾向上。

parameter_registry.name: premium_margin_survival_budget
parameter_registry.prohibition: 研究程序不得替用户发明风险预算。

contract_and_settlement: underlying, multiplier, currency, exercise style and settlement must match all four legs
early exercise, dividend, borrow and pin branches are explicit
entry and liquidation use side-and-quantity-aware executable quotes
entry_gates: all four canonical contracts resolve without ambiguity
both shoulder minima and account liquidation floor pass after costs
combo depth or legging path is observable
rebalance_transitions: any discretionary hedge creates a separately versioned dynamic policy
risk_limits: maximum executable quantity and legging exposure

evaluation_contract.terminal_payoff: Exact four-region payoff and shoulder minima after realized entry financing and costs.
evaluation_contract.path_revaluation: Full spot × time × volatility-surface revaluation with early-exercise and margin states.
evaluation_contract.costs: Executable entry, hedge if any, assignment, close and liquidation costs.
evaluation_contract.margin: Account-specific peak initial, maintenance and stressed liquidation margin.
evaluation_contract.holdout: Freeze selection before chronological and regime holdout; report every trial.
metrics: incremental value versus B3 and no-trade

hard_rejects: net credit is used as proof of no loss
executable cost, depth, margin or survival path is missing
no stable increment over B3 under the same budget
known_unknowns: whether this is Xu Zhe's actual undisclosed combination
current optimal strikes, expiries and quantities
